category.name: Beauty
category.expected: Order-count-led festive lift. Beauty grows through purchase frequency and new buyers; order value usually stays flat.

outcome.headline: Clean after evidence provided
outcome.detail: Merchant shared delivery confirmations and dispatch capacity in one round. Released on day 3. 0.9% disputes, all delivery delays.

learning.approve: Viral reel leading volume by 2h confirmed demand; delivery-complaint count now weighted as a capacity signal, not a fraud signal, for beauty.
learning.modify: Analyst adjusted the request scope; delivery proof for high-value orders kept as the deciding evidence for beauty spikes.
